tasks.question: When a workflow step calls `StepResponse.permanentFailure()`, where is that error recognised by the orchestrator so that the step is failed for good instead of retried?
tasks.search: StepResponse permanentFailure permanent step failure error retry
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v2.21.2: StepResponse.permanentFailure throws PermanentStepFailureError; TransactionOrchestrator.executeSyncStep (1240) and executeAsyncStep (1291) test PermanentStepFailureError.isPermanentStepFailureError(error) and call handleStepFailure(..., true) (forced permanent failure) instead of the retryable path.

tasks.question: Where is the available quantity of an inventory item across several stock locations computed (stocked minus reserved)?
tasks.search: inventory item available quantity stock locations stocked reserved
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v2.21.2: InventoryModuleService.retrieveAvailableQuantity delegates to inventoryLevelService_.getAvailableQuantity, which calls InventoryLevelRepository.getAvailableQuantity: a knex query on inventory_level summing raw_stocked_quantity - raw_reserved_quantity over the given location ids.

tasks.question: With the Redis locking provider, where is the lock lease extended while a long-running job still holds it, and what happens when the lease is lost?
tasks.search: redis lock lease extend renew long running job lost
tasks.verifiedBy: Read redis-lock.ts@v2.21.2: RedisLockingProvider.execute acquires the keys then starts renewUntilStopped(keys, ownerId, expireSeconds), which re-runs the owner-checked extendLock Lua command every third of the lease and aborts the job's signal with a CONFLICT error when a key was lost; execute rethrows signal.reason.

tasks.question: In the workflow engine, what happens when a step fails permanently: how does the transaction switch to compensation and which steps get rolled back?
tasks.search: workflow transaction step permanent failure compensate rollback
tasks.verifiedBy: Read transaction-orchestrator.ts@v2.21.2: setStepFailure marks PERMANENT_FAILURE once failures > maxRetries and sets flow.state = WAITING_TO_COMPENSATE unless continueOnPermanentFailure/skipOnPermanentFailure; checkAllSteps then switches to COMPENSATING and calls flagStepsToRevert (beginCompensation on done/failed steps); computeCurrentTransactionState then walks getCompensationSteps (steps sorted by depth, deepest first).

tasks.question: How is a 'buy X get Y' promotion applied to cart items: which items qualify, and how are the bought and the discounted quantities consumed over repeated applications?
tasks.search: buy get promotion eligible items quantities apply
tasks.verifiedBy: Read buy-get.ts@v2.21.2: getComputedActionsForBuyGet filters buy and target items with filterItemsByPromotionRules, computes remaining quantities, then loops (bounded by MAX_PROMOTION_ITERATIONS) over preparePromotionApplicationState + applyPromotionToTargetItems, updating eligible quantities each round.

tasks.question: When a product variant has a default price plus sale and override price-list prices, how does the pricing module pick the calculated price and the original price?
tasks.search: pricing calculated price original price price list sale override
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v2.21.2: PricingRepository.calculatePrices queries candidate prices for the context; PricingModuleService.calculatePrices groups them per price set: OVERRIDE price-list price wins (calculated and original), SALE takes the lower of price-list and default price, original = non-sale price-list price or default.
